verdicts.reason: A has a sensible banner split, with the quote on the left and the product on the right. But the quote now sets smaller than the bold attribution, so the hierarchy is inverted. The quote mark leaves a large gap above the text, the logo floats at top-left without lining up with the copy column, and the can only half overlaps the circle. B makes the same inverted quote/attribution hierarchy worse: the can is shrunk to a tiny afterthought on the far left, cut off from its backdrop circle, so the circle sits empty as dead weight on the right. The quote mark floats far from its text and nothing lines up across the three scattered clusters.
